c.title: $5,000 / 3br - 1446ft2 - 3 bedrooms townhome *Sasamat Garden* (Point Grey, Vancouver West)
c.description:
This three-bedroom townhouse at highly sought after Sasamat Gardens in Point Grey is on the market and ready for a family. Granite countertops and stainless steel appliance package complement the kitchen. A lovely west-facing deck accessed by french doors from the living room will allow you to enjoy the afternoon sun. With a master bedroom and ensuite bath on the main floor and two bedrooms up you will be amazed at how well the space has been planned. Massive 362 sqft. storage room and 2 underground parking spots. Within a 2 minute walk to the best that Point Grey has to offer- shopping, dining, transit, parks, great schools, the beach & the forest.
